execution.ref: claude/graphite-pod-logs-baseline-retry (GRAPHITE-POD-LOGS-RETRY-01), after Graphite R2 run 4 at REF 05cfb321
execution.description: Built the two fixes the owner approved after run 4: keep the logs of a pod run that did not score, bounded and checked, as operator evidence; and retry a session's failed baseline once, Carbon-side, under a registered policy (baseline-retry-v1).

expected: A failed pod's exported logs explain its failure, and one flaky baseline pod does not leave a whole session's scored proposals without a baseline.
observed: In run 4, 4 of 11 pods exited 1 inside the practice program after compile and digest verification passed. program.log and phase.log were exported and digested into the pod ledger but their bodies were never written, so the exception could not be read after the pods were terminated. The baseline was one of the four, and with no retry every later scored proposal was NO_BASELINE and never promotable. Building the retry showed that under pod-attribution-v1 a program claim at phase 3's recorded Level 0 is CANDIDATE_FAILED, so an infrastructure-only retry would not have helped run 4. The owner then directed "Yes, retry baseline crashes": after a check that the baseline's recipe, seed and pod are Carbon's alone, the session baseline's program crash is retried once too, while agent proposals keep #573's attribution and are never retried. A bounded local check of the seed-dependence hypothesis ran the pod phase on CPU (JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu) for the four failing recipes at full step counts, 200 seeds each plus 200 runs of nearby variants (1,004 runs): none exited non-zero and none produced non-finite predictions, so no seed-dependent raise was reproduced on CPU; GPU numerics and the pod environment were not tested.
keep: Digest every exported file into the ledger, and keep the bodies of the ones that explain a failure.
Make a retry rule a registered, versioned policy with invariants checked at load, so the Attacker can test it and a change is a new version.
A dry run drives every failure path a live run has met, with scripted pods, beside the happy path.
change: pod_logs keeps program.log and phase.log for unscored proposals under the session root: head 16 KiB and tail 48 KiB per file, 256 KiB per proposal, only when the bytes match the pod's listed sha256 and name no protected material, with the traceback's exception class noted.

baseline_retry applies to the session's baseline only and retries FAILED_INFRA from a pod that ran, or the baseline's program crash (CANDIDATE_FAILED, program); never CANDIDATE_RESOURCE_EXCEEDED, a launch refusal or a second time. It decides once, right after the baseline fails, before the triggering proposal's pod; the retry reruns the same strategy and seed and must fit the pod limit, the money cap, the remaining time and the launch gate with the waiting proposal's pod.
phase3 run --dry-run fails unless experiment.failure_path_check is OK.
